# NASHP - National Academy for State Health Policy

> > NASHP is a nonpartisan forum for state health policymakers to develop and share innovative solutions to improve health and health care across the United States.

The National Academy for State Health Policy (NASHP) provides research, technical assistance, and policy analysis to help states address complex health policy challenges. Based in Portland, Maine and Washington, DC, NASHP serves as a trusted resource for state officials working on Medicaid, public health, health equity, and health system transformation.

## Key Topics

- State health policy
- Medicaid innovation
- Public health strategies
- Childhood lead poisoning prevention
- Lead screening and treatment
- Health equity
- State policymakers
- Nonpartisan policy analysis
- State health reform
- Technical assistance for states
- Health care delivery
- Rhode Island case studies
- Community health interventions

## Public Health Initiatives

- [State Levers to Promote Lead Screening and Treatment: Rhode Island's Strategies](https://nashp.org/state-levers-to-promote-lead-screening-and-treatment-rhode-islands-strategies): Rhode Island's state strategies for childhood lead screening and treatment
